meta.title: Limit Analytic 5 V1
meta.prompt: The cards on the left below contain limits of the form \(0/0\). The slots on the right contain limits of functions that agree at all but one point with one of the functions on the left, and for which the limit is no longer of the form \(0/0\). Match the limits on the left with an equivalent, simplified limit on the right, if possible.
